    jt."typename",
    j."benefits"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "jobtypes" jt ON j."jobtypeid" = jt."id"
WHERE j."benefits" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY jt."typename" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."benefits" ASC NULLS FIRST;
285:

JOIN "experiences" e ON e."applicant_id" = a."id"

310:
SELECT
    r."hotelid",
    AVG(r."number_of_stars") AS rating
FROM "reviews" r
GROUP BY r."hotelid";
323:
SELECT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    r."customer_reviews" AS review,
    r."number_of_stars" AS stars
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "hotels" h ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;

334:
SELECT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    AVG(r."number_of_stars") AS average_stars,
    COUNT(r."reviewid") AS review_count
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "reviews" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
GROUP BY h."hotelid", h."name"
ORDER BY average_stars DESC NULLS LAST;
